description: This file defines the CustomVariable class, which models a custom object in the code generation framework. It extends BaseVariable and provides methods for generating C and Java code representations of custom objects, including handling serialization/deserialization, structure definitions, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: CustomVariable
classes.description: Represents a custom object in the code generation system, capable of producing C and Java code to represent, serialize, and deserialize the object based on XML-defined schema. It includes handling for fields of various types, nested custom objects, and code generation for data encoding/decoding.

methods.name: getLocalName
methods.description: Returns the custom name used locally, falling back to the variable name if localName is not set.

methods.name: getParentClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the parent class for code generation purposes.

methods.name: isParentClassAbstract
methods.description: Indicates whether the parent class is abstract, affecting code generation.

methods.name: isCloneable
methods.description: Checks if the custom variable is marked as cloneable.

methods.name: addVariable
methods.description: Adds a BaseVariable (field) to this custom object.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the list of fields (variables) within this custom object.

methods.name: doesCustomHaveArray
methods.description: Checks recursively if any field within the custom object is an array.

methods.name: getArrayVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all array-type fields within this custom object recursively.

methods.name: doesCustomHaveMap
methods.description: Checks recursively if any field within the custom object is a map.

methods.name: getMapVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all map-type fields within this custom object recursively.

methods.name: getStringVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all string-type fields.

methods.name: getJsonVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all JSON-type fields.

methods.name: getCustomVariables
methods.description: Retrieves all nested CustomVariable fields.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Provides the C type name associated with this variable.

methods.name: getInterfaceString
methods.description: Returns a string of additional Java interfaces implemented by this custom object.

methods.name: getNativeStructString
methods.description: Generates the C struct definition string for this custom object.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class name, formatted in camel case.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key name for this variable.

methods.name: getJavaGetter
methods.description: Generates Java getter method code for this variable.

methods.name: getJavaSetter
methods.description: Generates Java setter method code for this variable.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Produces C code to encode this custom variable into JSON.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Produces C code to decode this custom variable from JSON.

methods.name: generateJavaPojo
methods.description: Creates Java POJO code snippets for the custom object, including fields, getters/setters, and encode/decode methods using a template system.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to encode this variable into a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to decode this variable from a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Provides the Java IPC object type name, formatted in camel case.
